GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Cell ● Types of microscopes ● Differences between light and electron microsc.

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Decomposers only

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a? (1 mark)

   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts
